meta.title: WorkBuddy + Trae + Qoder + LobsterAI Connect
meta.description: Pool WorkBuddy (China & international), Qoder CN, Trae CN and LobsterAI free quota into one DSH model picker: a shared conversation history, live credit multipliers, and one-click check-in from the panel. LobsterAI sign-in state and credits are read directly from the desktop client's local database, with no manual paste required.
